title: Apple reports Q1 numbers February 1
text:
Apple reports Q1 numbers February 1 January 27, 2018, 07:54:26 AM EDT By InvestorsObserver Shutterstock photo What's Happening 
iPhone maker Apple ( AAPL ) will report its fiscal first-quarter results after the market close February 1. The company is forecast to report earnings of $3.81 per share, up from $3.36 during the same period last year. AAPL shares are down 1.0% year to date. Technical Analysis 
AAPL was recently trading at $170.77, down $9.33from its 12-month high and $50.15 above its 12-month low. Overall technical indicators for AAPL are bullish and the stock is in a strong upward trend. The stock has recent support above $169.25, and recent resistance below $179.50. Of the 29 analysts who cover the stock, 16 rate it a "strong buy", three rate it a "buy", eight rate it a "hold", and two rate it a "strong sell". AAPL gets a score of 60 from InvestorsObserver's Stock Score Report. Analyst's Thoughts 
Apple always catches the attention of Wall Street when it reports its quarterly numbers The company tends to understate its guidance numbers, so chances are good that an earnings beat is coming. The street believes this to be the case, with a whisper number of $3.94 versus the $3.81 consensus. While the company is likely to top estimates, the primary focus will be on the iPhone. The iPhone is the key revenue and profit driver for the company, and any weakness or slowdown in demand for the popular smart device will push shares lower, especially during the holiday quarter, and with the recent release of its new iPhone lineup. Expect an earnings beat, but watch for iPhone sales numbers, as those will be the driving force behind the stock following the report. Some analysts have recently lowered their sales forecast for iPhones during the quarter, and these lower estimates have pushed the stock down modestly on the year, but the good news for investors is that these downward revisions have already been priced into the stock, providing a good opportunity for shares to rally if results are better than expected. Stock Only Trade If you're looking to establish a long stock position in AAPL, consider buying the stock under $170.50. Sell if it falls below $143.50 or take profits if it gets to $196.00. Bullish Trade 
If you want a bullish hedged trade on the stock, consider a March 145/150 bull-put credit spread for a 35-cent credit. That's a potential 7.5% return (56.1% annualized*) and the stock would have to fall 11.9% to cause a problem. Bearish Trade 
If you want to take a bearish stance on the stock at this time, consider a March 195/200 bear-call credit spread for a $0.25 credit. That's a potential 5.3% return (39.2% annualized*) and the stock would have to rise 14.3% to cause a problem. Covered Call Trade If you like the stock, but wish to lower your cost basis on a new position, you may want to consider an April $170.00 covered call. Buy AAPL shares (typically 100 shares, scale as appropriate), while selling the April $170.00 call for a debit of $161.95 per share. The trade has a target assigned return of 5.0%, and a target annualized return of 21.8% (for comparison purposes only).
